blocks.content: Course: React Query: The Practical Guide
The project has five files and here is what each one does:

items: src/index.jsx — entry point of your app, this is where we wired up React Query
src/TaskList.jsx — where you'll build everything throughout the course

blocks.content:
1import React from 'react'
2import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
3import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
4import { ReactQueryDevtools } from '@tanstack/react-query-devtools'
5import App from './App'
6
7const queryClient = new QueryClient({
8  defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 1000 * 60 } }
9})
10
11createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(
12  <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
13    <App />
14    <ReactQueryDevtools />
15  </QueryClientProvider>
16)
In index.jsx we added three things:

items: QueryClient — creates the cache where React Query stores all your data
QueryClientProvider — wraps your whole app so every component can use that cache
ReactQueryDevtools — adds a floating panel in the corner so you can see what is cached and when things are refetching

blocks.content: From this point on, every component in your app can talk to React Query.
